---
title: "hpv"
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
cm_all_ages <- read.csv("data/cm_all_ages.csv") 
gt(cm_all_ages)
```

```{r}
total_num <- cm_all_ages |> pull(N_individuals) |> sum()
print(total_num)

tp <- cm_all_ages |> filter(Cytology == "Abnormal", HPV_Status == "HPV+") |> pull(N_individuals)
fp<- cm_all_ages |> filter(Cytology == "Normal", HPV_Status == "HPV+") |> pull(N_individuals)
tn<- cm_all_ages |> filter(Cytology == "Normal", HPV_Status == "HPV-") |> pull(N_individuals)
fn<- cm_all_ages |> filter(Cytology == "Abnormal", HPV_Status == "HPV-") |> pull(N_individuals)

prop_abnormal_given_hpv <- (tp/(tp + fp)) |> print()


prop_abnormal_given_no_hpv <- (fn/(tn + fn)) |> print()

prop_hpv_given_abnormal <- (tp/(tp + fn)) |> print()
prop_no_hpv_given_normal <- (tn/(tn + fp)) |> print()
```
